definitions.explanation: The rate at which something moves or happens.

examples.japanese: {制限|せいげん}{速度|そくど}を{守|まも}ってください。
{光|ひかり}の{速度|そくど}は{非常|ひじょう}に{速|はや}い。
examples.english: The speed of light is extremely fast.

examples.japanese: {速度|そくど}を{上|あ}げる{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to increase the speed.

notes:
{速度|そくど} is a technical/formal term for speed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制限|せいげん}{速度|そくど} (speed limit)
- {最高|さいこう}{速度|そくど} (maximum speed)
- {速度|そくど}を{落|お}とす (to reduce speed)
- {速度|そくど}{違反|いはん} (speeding violation)
- {処理|しょり}{速度|そくど} (processing speed)
- {通信|つうしん}{速度|そくど} (communication speed)

COMPARISON:
- {速度|そくど}: speed (formal/technical)
- スピード: speed (casual, from English)
- {速|はや}さ: speed, quickness (general)
